DT_PalLongDescriptionText.PAL_LONG_DESC_OniGhostGirl:
It lives entirely for the thrill of the scare, but is utterly un-frightening.
As most cannot help but indulge it with feigned surprise for its cuteness,
<characterName id=|OniGhostGirl|/> now leaves a trail of smiles in its wake.

Gathers <itemName id=|PalUpgradeStone| style=|Status_Keyword|/> when assigned to <mapObjectName id=|MonsterFarm|/>.
DT_PalLongDescriptionText.PAL_LONG_DESC_ThunderFluffyBird:
With so little to eat at high altitudes, 
it will occasionally even feast on its enemies' brains.
It is thought that groups seeking a more dependable food source 
descended to lower skies, ultimately diverging into <characterName id=|ThunderBird|/>.

Pecks pebbles of <itemName id=|SkyIslandOre| style=|Status_Keyword|/> while assigned to <mapObjectName id=|MonsterFarm|/>.
DT_PalLongDescriptionText.PAL_LONG_DESC_SleeveRabbit:
It uses the long, flowing fur on its hands to attract attention, 
always taking the utmost care to keep them maintained.
Highly sensitive to dirt and meticulously clean, 
kicking up dust nearby will invite a very disgusted glare.

Combines wild plants to create something to cheer up its tamer with while assigned to <mapObjectName id=|MonsterFarm|/>.

DT_PalFirstActivatedInfoText.PAL_FIRST_SPAWN_DESC_OniGhostGirl:
While in party, 
attacking enemies afflicted with <uiCommon id=|ADDITIONAL_EFFECT_Poison| style=|Effect_Poison|/> reduces their Attack by <Status_Up>{Passive1_EffectValue1}%</>. 
(Does not stack)

Gathers <itemName id=|PalUpgradeStone| style=|Status_Keyword|/> when assigned to <mapObjectName id=|MonsterFarm|/>.
DT_PalFirstActivatedInfoText.PAL_FIRST_SPAWN_DESC_ThunderFluffyBird:
While in party, 
increases the capture rate of Pals afflicted with <uiCommon id=|ADDITIONAL_EFFECT_Freeze| style=|Effect_Freeze|/>. (Does not stack)
{ReferenceMsgId_CaptureRate}

Pecks pebbles of <itemName id=|SkyIslandOre| style=|Status_Keyword|/> while assigned to <mapObjectName id=|MonsterFarm|/>.
DT_PalFirstActivatedInfoText.PAL_FIRST_SPAWN_DESC_SleeveRabbit:
While in party, 
reduces the <Status_Keyword>Partner Skill cooldowns</> for other party Pals by <Status_Up>{Passive1_EffectValue2}%</>. (Does not stack)

Combines wild plants to create something to cheer up its tamer with while assigned to <mapObjectName id=|MonsterFarm|/>.
